title: SemanticConcepts
description: The weighted concept capture behind the dashboard word cloud (output/dashboard/semantic-concepts.json): a paid model reading of the whole projected corpus, staged to cache/dashboard and validated against this schema before promotion (dashboard.sh, in-memory via validate.py — no per-datum matrix, the markdownConversation precedent). Two consumers, each taking what it needs: the dashboard uses the weights (cloud sizing); indexing borrows only the names (candidate headwords).

SemanticConcepts.title: SemanticConcepts
SemanticConcepts.description: A format_table-styled two-column table: the concept names and their salience weights.

rows.description: At least one concept — an empty capture is a failed capture.

ConceptRow.title: ConceptRow
ConceptRow.description: One concept: [word, count]. The count is SALIENCE, not raw frequency — the model scales the top concept to 100.

items.description: Key concept or theme (word or short phrase).
